title: Halving-loop instruction
statement:
For a natural number $E$, two registers $c,r
ame$ in a set of $18$ registers, an exit label $e$, a function $m$ assigning one of the labels $m(0),m(1),m(2)$ to each phase, and a phase $j\in\{0,1,2\}$, define the instruction as follows: at phase $0$, branch on whether register $c$ is zero, going to $e$ if it is and to $m(1)$ otherwise; at phase $1$, decrement $c$ and go to $m(2)$; at phase $2$, halve register $r$ and go to $m(0)$.
